description:
Manage Focus version with the following actions:

- **service**: MCP package version plus the Focus API service revision. mcp.package is this published MCP package version (e.g. 1.8.0). focus_api is the Focus API process revision (git SHA / build number) — it does not change when you update the npm MCP package. (data: none)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

name: version
title: Version
